title: Apple Display Coprocessor (DCP) RTKit Microkernel & Memory Architecture

critical_threads.name: VFTG_Subframe_ISR
critical_threads.role: Hard real-time VSYNC generation, flexible vertical timing, and Tearing Effect (TE) synchronization.

critical_threads.name: PIODMA_Tagging_Worker
critical_threads.role: Programmed I/O DMA descriptor scheduling and hardware compensation LUT transfers.

critical_threads.name: SWMPR_Refresh_Governor
critical_threads.role: Software-Managed Pixel Refresh state machine, evaluating frame intervals and dynamic refresh rate requests.

critical_threads.name: AOP_Flipbook_Consumer

critical_threads.name: BICS_Aging_Accumulator
critical_threads.role: Calculates long-term subpixel luminance accumulation for OLED burn-in compensation.

dcp_firmware_dram.name: dcp_runtime_window
dcp_firmware_dram.role: DCP code, RTKit heap pools, task descriptors, and pipe state context tables.

disp_framebuffer_pool.name: disp0_isoc_dram_pool
disp_framebuffer_pool.role: Tandem OLED ProMotion triple framebuffers (2868x1320 @ 4 bytes/pixel), HDR/EDR metadata planes, and alpha surfaces.

calibration_lut_carveout.name: dcp_lut_staging_window
calibration_lut_carveout.role: 2D PCC Local Tone Mapping LUTs, Subpixel Uniformity Compensation maps (SPUC), and BICS history matrices.
